data.title: Listening Test 1
data.description: Section 1: enquiring about a local language exchange club. Section 2: orientation at a public sports centre (floor plan labelling). Section 3: university research project on student travel and public transport. Section 4: lecture on forests and the water cycle.

data.title: Listening Test 2
data.description: Section 1: booking a room at a community centre. Section 2: orientation at a public library (building map labelling). Section 3: university research project on sleep and academic performance. Section 4: lecture on how coral reefs support marine ecosystems.

data.title: Listening Test 3
data.description: Section 1: enquiring about a local cooking course. Section 2: orientation at a community health centre (floor plan labelling). Section 3: university research project on student use of green transport. Section 4: lecture on how rivers shape landscapes.

data.title: Listening Test 4
data.description: Section 1: joining a local gardening club. Section 2: orientation at a community arts centre (building map labelling). Section 3: university research project on food waste among students. Section 4: lecture on the role of wetlands in the environment.

data.title: Listening Test 5
data.description: Part 1: A man phones a community centre to hire its hall for his mother's seventieth birthday party. Part 2: A volunteer coordinator briefs a group of new volunteers before a city farm's open day. Part 3: Two students, Kirsty and Owen, discuss their joint dissertation on food-packaging waste in supermarkets with their tutor, Dr Lawson. Part 4: A lecturer gives a talk on what glass is and how glassmaking developed from the ancient world to the present.

data.title: Listening Test 6
data.description: Part 1: A woman phones a city car-share club to become a member. Part 2: A local radio presenter introduces the council's heritage officer, who describes a new heritage trail in the town. Part 3: Two students, Hannah and Liam, prepare a seminar presentation on how young children acquire language. Part 4: A lecturer in urban geography gives a talk on the causes and effects of urban heat islands and on ways of reducing them.

data.title: Listening Test 7
data.description: Part 1: A man phones a holiday company to book a week on a canal narrowboat for his family. Part 2: The front-of-house manager at a theatre gives an induction talk to a group of new volunteer ushers. Part 3: Two geography students, Hannah and Callum, discuss the draft of their field-trip report on river bank erosion with their lecturer, Dr Mercer. Part 4: A lecturer in economic history gives a talk on the economics of the English wool trade in the Middle Ages.

data.title: Listening Test 8
data.description: Part 1: A man who has recently moved to Australia phones a running club about becoming a member and entering its charity ten-kilometre race. Part 2: A primary school head teacher briefs parents at an evening meeting about the Year Six outdoor education week. Part 3: Two postgraduate students discuss the results of their survey into how people in the city commute and use public transport. Part 4: An engineering lecturer explains how suspension bridges are built, how they carry loads, and the problems caused by wind, pedestrians and corrosion.

data.title: Listening Test 9
data.description: Part 1: A young woman phones a letting agency to register as a tenant and hear about three flats that might suit her. Part 2: A museum curator introduces a group of visitors to a new exhibition of historical maps and explains the layout of the gallery. Part 3: An environmental science student discusses a draft of his presentation on bioplastics with his tutor. Part 4: An archaeology lecturer explains how new evidence has changed ideas about where and when the horse was domesticated.
